### Humbling Reality
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/humbling-reality-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-11.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 9:6
Points:
- Pride sets people up for a fall, whereas humility acknowledges our propensity to go wrong.
- Israel might easily have assumed that God's lavish deliverance and provision meant they were righteous.
- Moses confronted the Israelites with their stubbornness to keep them grounded in reality.
- God reminds His people of their unworthiness to guard them against destructive self-satisfaction.
- Genuine gratitude for God's unmerited mercy produces loving, obedient hearts.

### Not Because of Your Righteousness
Author: W. Robert Godfrey
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/posts/not-because-your-righteousness
Passage: Deuteronomy 9:4
Points:
- Moses cautions believers never to believe their blessings are earned through personal goodness.
- Canaan was dispossessed because of the wickedness of the resident nations, not Israel's integrity.
- God gives His people their inheritance to confirm His covenant promises to the patriarchs.
- The Lord acts to rescue a stubborn people rather than reward a righteous people.
- Christians stand as recipients of divine grace solely through God's sovereign, unmerited mercy.
